digest.component_or_area: structured-output orchestration / RP-01 Pydantic AI migration
propositions: Historical Rebar structured-output behavior must be reconstructed from 15 ticket aliases and existing test suites before Pydantic AI seam replacement can be approved.
Pydantic AI 1.107.2 native output, retry, fallback, usage limits, and error-handling seams must be exercised offline without live model calls and compared against current observable Rebar behavior.

Seven maintainer decisions govern the behavioral contract: one operation-wide request budget, complete failed response on proven fit only, bounded output-size retry, terminal refusal/filter, aggregate successful-run usage, exact cause-chain error restoration, and trace-based candidate observability.
All seven RP-01 Phase-4 decisions were approved by 2026-08-16; implementation ticketization is deferred to the pydantic-ai lane and is out of scope for this research task.
